what_you_believe_happened: Signed in as accounts.audit. Found Money > Reports & tax > Tax & Recurring sub-tab, which has a 'Company GST & TDS settings' card (Company, GSTIN, State, 'TDS deductor active?' and a 'Send settings for approval' button). The brief gave no GSTIN value or TDS choice (only 'Company exists'), and rules forbid inventing data, so I did not enter or submit anything. The GSTIN box shows grey text 29ABCDE1234F1Z5 that looks like a placeholder; TDS deductor shows 'No (under threshold)'. Nothing was saved.
incorrect_navigation_attempts: Money > Books & cash (landing page, no settings)
Money > Ledger & setup (despite the 'setup' label, it holds no company tax settings; scrolled it twice)
Money > Reports & tax first sub-tab (reports only)
unnecessary_steps: Scrolling the whole Ledger & setup page
confusing_terminology: Ledger & setup -> sounds like where company settings live but is not
Reports & tax -> settings are on the secondary pill 'Tax & Recurring', not named GST
'TDS deductor active? No (under threshold)' -> unclear how it relates to 'default TDS settings'
'Send settings for approval' -> unclear what happens next or who approves
missing_feedback: Not tested submission; no hint on screen whether GSTIN grey text is a placeholder or saved value
unexpected_behaviour: Page scroll did not work until the mouse was moved over the content area
Settings are buried below a calculator on the same page
visual_issues: GSTIN example text is grey and looks similar to a filled value
Company settings card is below the fold under an unrelated calculator
accessibility_issues: Not assessed beyond screenshots; could not verify keyboard use
observations: Feature exists and is reasonably labelled once found, but the path (Money > Reports & tax > Tax & Recurring > scroll) is not obvious. There is no default TDS section/rate setting visible, only an on/off deductor toggle. Test could not complete as no GSTIN value was provided.

rating_justifications.feature_discoverability: Took three wrong screens (Books, Ledger & setup, Reports) before finding the settings under Reports & tax > Tax & Recurring, below a calculator.
